newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan first 20 days trade deficit Y350.68 bln.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan first 20 days trade deficit Y350.68 bln.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade deficit rose 23.4 percent to 350.68 billion yen in the first 20 days of January compared with a revised surplus of 284.28 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
Free on board (FOB) exports rose 13.4 percent to 1.74 trillion yen from a year earlier, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 14.9 percent to 2.09 trillion yen.
